title: Predicting wet-lab replication yield from multi-site assay metadata

findings.message: The event-per-predictor ratio is too low for stable adjusted effects.
findings.remediation: Reduce predictors, use penalization, or present the model as exploratory until stability is demonstrated.

findings.message: Binary outcomes should not be released through an identity-link linear model without an explicit sensitivity justification.
findings.remediation: Refit with a logistic or mixed-effects logistic model, or add a documented sensitivity analysis before AI review conclusions are trusted.

findings.message: The reviewer handoff is missing sensitivity evidence or links to diagnostics.
findings.remediation: Hold automated peer-review approval until the handoff packet includes diagnostics and sensitivity results.

findings.message: Separation indicators suggest coefficient estimates may be unstable or infinite.
findings.remediation: Use penalized logistic regression or exact methods and report the separation diagnostic in the reviewer packet.

findings.message: Residual autocorrelation may invalidate nominal uncertainty estimates.
findings.remediation: Model temporal or batch correlation explicitly, or use clustered uncertainty estimates.

findings.message: Binary prediction claims need calibration evidence before reviewer summaries treat them as reliable.
findings.remediation: Add calibration curve, Brier score, or held-out calibration summary.

findings.message: Residual variance is not constant and no robust standard errors were declared.
findings.remediation: Report robust or clustered standard errors and flag affected inference in the limitations section.

findings.message: Predictors show high variance inflation, so independent-effect claims may be overstated.
findings.remediation: Collapse correlated predictors, use regularization, or downgrade independent-effect language.

findings.message: The manuscript claims diagnostics were considered but does not disclose assumption risk in limitations.
findings.remediation: Add limitation language that names the specific modeling assumptions still under review.

findings.message: Residual skew or influential outliers are large enough to require sensitivity reporting.
findings.remediation: Add influence diagnostics, robust fit sensitivity, and a reviewer-facing note describing impacted claims.

findings.message: Cluster-adjusted claims are fragile with very few clusters.
findings.remediation: Report cluster limitations and avoid generalizing beyond the observed sites or batches.
